title: Center console storage and armrest usability
summary: Feedback on the G70 center console centers on storage usefulness, armrest comfort, and control placement, with many fragments describing features or requests without a clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the armrest comfort, heated console surfaces, and handy console space for keeping small items out of sight.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on small storage space, an armrest positioned too close to console controls, and nonfunctioning console volume controls.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention console controls, small storage, locking and cooling requests, and armrest heating without enough context to confirm satisfaction or dissatisfaction.

limitations: Many sampled fragments are undetermined, so the available examples do not provide enough context to fully resolve sentiment for several console-related remarks.
One sampled positive fragment about start-button placement contains potentially conflicting wording, so examples are insufficient to clarify that specific opinion beyond the assigned sentiment.
This topic mixes storage, armrest comfort, control layout, and control functionality, so it is not a single tightly focused issue.
